tasks.title: Print ASCII OK and FAILED lines from validate-plugins
Make every tracked scripts/ci file ASCII
Guard scripts/ci against non-ASCII with a reusable checker
Prove the CLI output and CI wiring, then run the gates

acceptanceMatrix.expected: validate-plugins.mjs holds no byte above 0x7E; emitResult writes 'plugin configuration OK - ' and 'plugin configuration FAILED - ' with the rest of each message unchanged
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: commit 80dd8b48 changes only the 4 U+2014 lines (2, 6, 47, 50) of scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs to ' - '; the file at this head is 3442 bytes with max byte 0x7D; line 47 writes `plugin configuration OK - ${scanned}` and line 50 writes `plugin configuration FAILED - ${violations.length} violation(s) across ${scanned}`, wording otherwise unchanged

acceptanceMatrix.expected: with a planted violation, node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs exits 1 and every stdout byte is at most 0x7E apart from LF; the first line starts 'plugin configuration FAILED - '
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: a planted untracked root file zz-plant-904.json holding '{ not json' (checkJsonSyntax parses every root-level .json); node scripts/ci/validate-plugins.mjs exit 1, stdout captured as a Buffer through spawnSync, 246 bytes, max byte except LF 0x7D; first line 'plugin configuration FAILED - 1 violation(s) across 5 plugins, 24 skills, 13 agents, 2 output styles, 100 JSON files, 160 shipped docs', then the file and its 'not valid JSON' message; the plant was removed in a finally block and git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all was empty afterwards

acceptanceMatrix.expected: no tracked file under scripts/ci holds a byte above 0x7E; git diff -U0 on the touched files shows only em-dash to hyphen replacements; Biome check on scripts/ci/ passes
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: a byte check over all 38 tracked scripts/ci files and the 12 changed files reports 0 non-ASCII bytes; before T1 the same scan found 28 code points, all U+2014, in 9 files; git diff -U0 origin/master: 28 changed lines in the 9 files, each pair differing only in U+2014 to '-' (a pairwise check reported 24 pairs, 0 mismatches for T2, and T1's 4 lines read by hand); Biome check on the 11 touched scripts/ci files exit 0, 0 errors (311 warnings, report-only)

acceptanceMatrix.expected: scripts/ci/ascii-only.test.mjs is listed in package.json test:ci-scripts; its repository row runs the helper over git ls-files scripts/ci and finds no rows; ci.yml build-test runs npm test, which runs test:ci-scripts
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: package.json:14 test:ci-scripts ends with scripts/ci/ascii-only.test.mjs and package.json:13 test chains npm run test:ci-scripts; .github/workflows/ci.yml:51 '- run: npm test' is in the build-test job (lines 35-52); 'every tracked scripts/ci file is ASCII' ok in npm test's test:ci-scripts block, and it throws when the listing is empty so it cannot pass on an empty list; the listing uses git ls-files -z, and 'a tracked file with a non-ASCII name is read and its row reported' ok (temp repo, tracked scripts/ci/caf<U+00E9>.mjs, row 'scripts/ci/caf<U+00E9>.mjs:1 U+2014'; the pre-fix listing with core.quotePath=true returned the C-quoted path and threw ENOENT)

acceptanceMatrix.expected: the helper returns 'x.mjs:2 U+2014', a U+2192 row, and a U+FEFF row for inline fixtures built with String.fromCodePoint, and no rows for ASCII text with tab, LF, and CRLF
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: scripts/ci/ascii-only.test.mjs: 'an em-dash on line 2 is reported with its path, line, and code point' ok (deepEqual ['x.mjs:2 U+2014']); 'an arrow and a leading BOM are each reported' ok (['a.mjs:1 U+2192'], ['b.mjs:1 U+FEFF']); 'an astral character yields exactly one row' ok (['s.mjs:2 U+1F600']); 'ASCII text with tab, LF, and CRLF has no rows' ok; red check: with the threshold raised to 0x10FFFF the three fixture rows failed, and all 5 passed after restoring 0x7E (at 629e8103); at this head the file's 6 tests pass

acceptanceMatrix.expected: after a non-ASCII character is planted in a tracked scripts/ci file, npm run test:ci-scripts fails and names that path:line and code point; after the plant is reverted, it passes again
acceptanceMatrix.observed: pass: at this head, U+2014 (built with String.fromCodePoint) appended to line 2 of tracked scripts/ci/lib/fs-utils.mjs; node --test scripts/ci/ascii-only.test.mjs exit 1 naming the row; npm run test:ci-scripts exit 1, pass 38, fail 1, 'not ok 6 - every tracked scripts/ci file is ASCII', output names 'scripts/ci/lib/fs-utils.mjs:2 U+2014'; the original bytes were written back (byte-identical, git status empty, no stash used) and npm run test:ci-scripts exit 0, 39 tests, 39 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped
